raw_reasoning:
Explain your reasoning in 2 to 4 sentences. Consider whose data or rights are affected, and whether they would reasonably expect to be asked first.

The proposed action directly affects all platform users' personal data by enrolling them into a data-sharing program without prior notification or agreement. Users have a reasonable expectation of privacy and control over their own information; retroactively assuming consent violates standard data-protection norms (such as GDPR or CCPA principles) that require affirmative, informed permission before sharing. Therefore the action cannot ethically or legally proceed without obtaining explicit user consent first. This is not an internal infrastructure change—it materially impacts individuals' rights and expectations.
